title: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries: 2025 edition — Phase 65 Water review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Water reporting pack. The 2025 edition extends the annual commodity, trade, and import-reliance record. Individual commodity methods and withheld data govern comparison.
key_findings: The 2025 edition extends the annual commodity, trade, and import-reliance record.
Method: Annual USGS commodity surveys, estimates, trade data, and methodological notes.
Denominator: Nonfuel mineral commodities and U.S. production covered in each annual edition.
why_it_matters: Which records distinguish plans and monitoring guidance from accepted assets, measured flows, service reliability, allocation, and compatible reuse outcomes? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This observation adds one of three time points for the usgs mineral commodity summaries series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Individual commodity methods and withheld data govern comparison.
The observation is bounded to United States with international trade context and the stated period.
The denominator is Nonfuel mineral commodities and U.S. production covered in each annual edition.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
